suite: DC-004 final source, documentation and evidence checks

actual.scope: Changed tracked and untracked Markdown only; target anchors are read without recursively auditing historical documents.

actual.notes: Preserved FAIL/TIMEOUT receipts are allowed when complete and hash-verifiable; this check never reclassifies them as successful test runs.
Pattern scan of changed deliverables, including decompressed gzip evidence; not a claim of exhaustive secret detection.

scopeNotes: Read-only repository inspection with optional Git locks disabled. No build/server/browser, dependency installation or repository mutation.
Only current changed tracked/untracked deliverables are audited; historical Markdown is read only when resolving a current local link.
Quality and browser outcomes remain their original evidence; receipt integrity is not test acceptance.
